title: Equivariant preparation and fixed-locus blowup charts
statement:
Let $f:(X,Z)\to(S,D)$ be a log smooth morphism of Noetherian fs log regular pairs [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], [def-per-fs-log-smooth-etale], with $X$ regular and $Z$ a $G$-strict strict normal crossings divisor. A log regular pair means its fs log structure is $\mathcal O\cap j_*\mathcal O^\times$ for the boundary complement $j$; strict normal crossings means locally a product of distinct regular parameters, with regular global components and regular intersections of the expected codimension. Let a finite group $G$ act tamely over $S$, trivially on $S$. Fix a geometric point $\bar x$ and replace $G$ by its inertia group there. For any subgroup $H\le G$, etale locally near this point and its image there is a strict equivariant etale comparison from $X$ to the pullback over $S$ of
$$Y=\operatorname{Spec}\Lambda[u_1^{\pm1},\ldots,u_t^{\pm1},z_1,\ldots,z_r,y_1,\ldots,y_s]\longrightarrow\Sigma=\operatorname{Spec}\Lambda[Q].$$
Here $Q$ is a sharp fs chart of $S$, $\Lambda$ is a localization of $\mathbf Z[1/N,\mu_N]$ with $N$ invertible at the point, $N$ annihilates the inertia group, $\mu_N$ denotes the $N$th roots of unity, $P=\mathbf Z^t\oplus\mathbf N^r$ is a chart for the boundary $T=(z_1\cdots z_r=0)$, and the map is induced by $\gamma:Q\to P$ with injective group completion and finite invertible torsion in its cokernel. The $u_j$ are fixed by inertia, each $z_j$ is an eigenvector, and the $y_j$ span a finite free inertia representation. Coordinates for the latter may be chosen after restriction to $H$ so that
$$Y^H=V(z_1,\ldots,z_m,y_1,\ldots,y_n)$$
for some $0\le m\le r$, $0\le n\le s$. If $H$ acts trivially, its fixed subscheme is the whole scheme and is omitted from the blowup procedure.

The blowup and the strict transform of the boundary commute with this comparison: for the model $X=S\times_\Sigma Y$, there are scheme isomorphisms
$$\operatorname{Bl}_{X^H}X=X\times_Y\operatorname{Bl}_{Y^H}Y,\qquad Z^{\rm st}=X\times_YT^{\rm st}.$$
The same assertions hold after the strict etale comparison. Here the fixed subscheme is the equalizer of all elements of $H$, the blowup is $\operatorname{Proj}\bigoplus_{a\ge0}I^a$, and strict transform is the closure of the inverse image away from the center. On the $z_i$ blowup chart ($1\le i\le m$), $z_j=z_i z'_j$ for $j\le m$, $j\ne i$, and $y_j=z_i y'_j$ for $j\le n$; all other variables are unchanged. Its boundary has monoid $\mathbf Z^t\oplus\mathbf N^r$, and the base map is $(1\oplus\beta_i)\gamma$ with $\beta_i(e_j)=e_j+e_i$ for $j\le m$, $j\ne i$, and all other basis vectors fixed. On the $y_i$ chart ($1\le i\le n$), $z_j=y_i z'_j$ for $j\le m$ and $y_j=y_i y'_j$ for $j\le n$, $j\ne i$. Its boundary has monoid $\mathbf Z^t\oplus\mathbf N^{r+1}$; the base map is $(1\oplus\delta)\gamma$ with $\delta(e_j)=e_j+e_{r+1}$ for $j\le m$ and $\delta(e_j)=e_j$ otherwise. In both cases the variables outside this monoid are polynomial variables; these charts cover the blowup.

from.place: Proof Step 3: dimension-normalized Verdier duality, regular finite-torsion local model; pointwise purity and composition used to compare the normalized curve with the ambient regular scheme. Input: Gabber purity for a regular Noetherian closed pair. More precisely: Expose XVI, section 3.7 second paragraph through its last paragraph, printed pp.254--255: semistable G-alteration, ell-Sylow H, tame equivariant modification, quotient over T=S prime/H, and log resolution. Geometric construction only, before applying Theorem 3.6.2 and Proposition 3.5.7; preliminary finite extension to normalize constants in the first paragraph. Specifically: XVI 3.7: equivariant modification X double-prime and log-smooth quotient X double-prime/H. Supporting construction and local calculations in ILO VIII 4--5 and X 1.2--1.8.
